title: Chapter 50: Anxious Sacrifice
content:
Chapter 50: Anxious Sacrifice

Facing the charging long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry, the puppies beside the hydralisk rushed forward.

The bugbear priest who was commanding the army to advance showed a smile on his face. As long as these puppies were eliminated, the remaining hydralisks and tiger cavalry of the Zerg would not change anything.

The overall situation of this war has been decided!

The bugbear army advanced steadily. The Zerg hydralisks' attack targets have always been on the lizardmen. The bugbear priest was happy to use the lizardmen to attract the long-range firepower of the Zerg.

Seeing that the puppies on the battlefield were exhausted and victory was in sight, a large number of puppies suddenly rushed out from the blind spot behind the battlefield and rushed directly to the long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry.

This incident made the bugbear priest's heart sink to the bottom of the valley. The thing he was most worried about happened.

He learned from the intelligence he collected during the battle with the Zerg yesterday that the Zerg had the habit of reserving troops, but he did not expect that in the face of such a big gap in troops, the Zerg would still play this trick of reserving troops.

"Does it feel good to beat the strong with the weak again and again?"

This is what he is most puzzled about.

"You obviously have the strength, why don't you show it?"

"What's the point of hiding it like this? Is it just to attack me?"

If it weren't for the constraints of faith, he would have wanted to curse.

The Zerg troops that came to support this time were about thousands. With their absolute numerical advantage, they took the lead in quickly destroying the frenzied long-armed ogres and bugbear cavalry that came forward.

As long as the Zerg has an absolute numerical advantage, there is no enemy that cannot be overwhelmed.

The army of the bugbear tribe could not provide support in time, and could only watch the most elite troops being destroyed.

"There is still a chance!"

The bugbear priest was not discouraged at this time.

The bear goblin infantry of the army of the bear goblins suffered almost no losses. This is the absolute main force. They can fight a few more tough battles like the one just now.

The army of the bear goblins pressed forward, and the puppies formed a defense line. Another brutal close combat began.

The main force of this battle became the bear goblin infantry.

The bear goblin priests began to bless the combat troops at all costs. At this time, the army of the bear goblin tribe still had an absolute advantage on the battlefield.

The close combat of the puppies bought attack time for 1,000 hydralisks, which have been steadily consuming the troops of the army of the bear goblins.

This accumulation of consumption is very terrible as time goes by.

Perhaps it won’t be long before the lizardmen will fall under the spikes of the hydralisks.

Maybe the bear goblins sent so many lizardmen just to consume the long-range attacks of the Zerg, but they didn’t expect that the sustained combat capability of the Zerg’s long-range attack troops was so strong.

Wu Qing also likes these lizardmen, and they deliver resources very quickly.

As the war continues, the task of the puppies is to kill as many enemies as possible while delaying time.

The defense line composed of thousands of puppies is enough to fight the army of the bugbears for a while.

Meng, who has been paying attention to the situation of the Zerg reinforcements, suddenly found that a small number of hydralisks have begun to appear among the reinforcements. They are slowly gathering together, and the number is increasing.

These are the hydralisks that Wu Qing hatched with the 5 Zerg mother nests in the new city of Daxia. Now there is no shortage of gas resources, and the number of hydralisks can be increased as much as possible.

The 50 mother nests in the Zerg territory need to hatch puppies continuously to ensure the continuity of the Zerg reinforcements. Wu Qing uses the mother nests in the new city to hatch some hydralisks.

In fact, if this war continues like this, there will be no problem for the Zerg to win if nothing unexpected happens. It doesn't matter if there are more hydralisks, and of course it's better to have them.

The puppies on the battlefield are rapidly decreasing, and the strength of the bugbear army has also dropped to a very dangerous level.

As the number of puppies decreased rapidly, a loophole appeared in the Zerg's defense line. The Lizardman Light Infantry, who had been passively beaten, broke through the defense line and took the initiative to charge at the Hydralisks.

The Bugbear Priest was betting on the Zerg's reinforcements. If the Zerg still had reinforcements, his goal would change from destroying the Zerg to consuming the Zerg's manpower as much as possible.

The Zerg, a race that can sacrifice continuously on the battlefield, is absolutely intolerable.

For the Bugbear Priest, whether it is Bugbear or other races, in his eyes, they are just tools of the spirit god's conquest, and no matter how much they are consumed, he will not be moved.

The concept of life and death has been completely distorted by these fanatics.

It can be said that these believers of the evil god are no longer normal intelligent creatures. It is not an exaggeration to say that they are puppets of the evil god.

This is also one of the reasons why the major local races are afraid of them. Normal people, no one wants to become such a monster that has lost himself.

This is the biggest motivation for the major local races to continue to fight.

The insufficient number of Lizardmen light infantry charged towards the Hydralisks, which was a complete suicide act. They fell one after another on the way of the charge and disappeared in light.

The Bugbear Infantry finally broke through the defense line of the Hounds, and the entire army pressed towards the position of the Hydralisks.

The surviving Hounds were surrounded and could only fight hard, and could no longer organize an effective defense line.

"Haha! Let you taste what despair is like!"

Looking at the army of the Bugbear tribe, which had lost most of its members and the two important arms of the Long-armed Ogres and Bugbear Cavalry were completely annihilated, he laughed triumphantly.

Not far behind him, another Zerg troop was gathering and waiting for orders, and they would rush to the battlefield as soon as they received an order.

This Zerg troop also had a team of hundreds of Hydralisks.

Meng was very impressed by the Zerg Hydralisks. Zerg battles were almost all conducted around a small number of Hydralisks.

Hydralisks were the core attack output force of the Zerg. These Hydralisks that came as reinforcements would definitely play a very important role on the battlefield.

Meng admired Wu Qing a little. Even though the battlefield was in such a state, he could still calmly leave the reinforcements there to watch the show, and he had to wait until the most critical moment to send them.

This not only made the enemy unbearable, but also frightened his own people.

Of course, he didn't know that these reinforcements were funded by the enemies on the opposite side. Without this war, there would be no reinforcements.

It wasn't that Wu Qing didn't want to use his power to put pressure on others, nor did he like to be mysterious, but he had no choice.

But he couldn't tell people about these things.

He could only act mysterious and different, which was really helpless.

The army of the bear goblin tribe launched another determined charge. The dawn of victory was just about to emerge, but it was extinguished by the large number of reinforcements from the Zerg!

"All-out attack!"

The bear goblin priest, who was hit, no longer cared about maintaining the formation of the army and directly ordered the whole army to attack.

He no longer had the patience to play this game with Wu Qing, so he just showed his cards and decided who would win and who would lose in one battle.

If the Zerg had reinforcements, he would also accept it. Now it was a matter of how strong the forces of both sides were.

"Haha, Wu Qing, look! These cunning evil god priests are also getting angry!"

"You really have a way to mess them up like this!"

Wu Qing didn't know how to answer Meng's words, but he was in a good mood when he saw the angry bear goblin priest.
